audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart said Skill at Level 6 and First item and Kled at 2+ items, while the content layer said Aatrox at Level 6 and 2+ items. Two layers rendered different answers, and the mirror (aatrox side) reads Aatrox at stages 5-7.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled,Kled,Skill,Skill,Aatrox,Aatrox,Aatrox and the mirror audit records Aatrox winning stages 5-7; Kled's frontloaded burst flattens while Aatrox's drain healing scales.
audit.corrected: Stages 5-7 set to Aatrox in BOTH layers, ratings inverted to 4/10, 4/10, 3/10, and the stage whys rewritten so they no longer claim a Kled spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Power-spike text never gave a cooldown number: 'Aatrox's R powers up his Q knockups and heal' with no duration, and Level 2 advice named no ability.
audit.why: Kit file: World Ender 120/100/80s, The Darkin Blade 14/12/10/8/6s, Kled Q 11/10/9/8/7s, W 13/12/11/10/9s. Concrete numbers make the sequencing advice actionable.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states World Ender at 120s; phases[1].why gives Darkin Blade's 14s rank-1 cooldown as the trade window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aatrox's abilities were never named (packet defect confirmed), and the anti-heal interaction was asserted only vaguely as 'his R'.
audit.why: Three separate sources of healing — Deathbringer Stance (P), Umbral Dash (E) passive heal-on-damage, World Ender (R) increased healing — are what beat Kled's extended trades, so Grievous Wounds timing is the decisive interaction. Also, only the outer edge of The Darkin Blade knocks up, which is what interrupts Kled's E dash.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d names all three healing sources and ties them to Grievous Wounds; dontsFull[1].d states the edge-only knockup; dosFull[0].d gives World Ender's 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zero sequencing cues in the packet.
audit.why: The Darkin Blade at 14s rank 1 is the punishable window early; World Ender at 120s rank 1 is the punishable window after 6.
audit.corrected: Both windows now stated with numbers in phases[1].why, phases[5].why and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: Q beartrap is the kill switch — land it and rip the combo. Only take the trade when Aatrox's World Ender is down.
edits.after: Beartrap (Q) is the kill switch — land it and rip W's four attacks. Aatrox's Darkin Blade is 14s rank 1; trade in its gap.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on World Ender's cooldown.
edits.after: His Eclipse turns long trades into heals he wins — fight only in his World Ender gap.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Aatrox carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Aatrox out-scales here: his drain healing only grows. Force the map with CHAAAARGE roams and close before two items become three.

edits.before: His drain spike. Anti-heal and trade short. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: World Ender runs 120s rank 1 and amps his healing — anti-heal, then engage.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Only the edge of The Darkin Blade knocks up — step inside it.

edits.before: Giving away the dismount for free — mounted HP is a resource; spending it on poke instead of all-ins loses the lane.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender all heal — without Grievous Wounds his bar refills faster than you empty it.

edits.before: Aatrox's R powers up his Q knockups and heal — his combo all-in now out-drains and CC-chains your dismount.
edits.after: World Ender (R) at 120s amps his AD and healing — his all-in now out-drains your dismount window.

notes: Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's own description does not support — the text describes a drag to centre plus damage only. Did not write any grounding claim into Kled's page (his E dash and R would be the things affected). Level chart stages 5-7 were flipped to Aatrox in matched pairs across both layers to resolve the pre-existing full/content disagreement and stay consistent with the already-audited mirror.
